criteria.why: Needs a real iPhone running Safari against staging after deploy; Playwright WebKit on Windows cannot reproduce Safari's real cross-site cookie enforcement.
criteria.text: On a real iPhone against staging: sign in, close Safari, reopen, still signed in.

Staging's fly.staging.toml sets SECURE_COOKIES=true so the rb_session cookie uses the cross-site-safe SameSite=None;Secure;Partitioned branch instead of SameSite=Lax (which Safari drops on cross-site fetches), documenting the fix for the staging-only cross-site workaround.
